Title: MyBlazorApp Architecture
Content:
## Solution Purpose
MyBlazorApp is a Blazor Server web application demonstrating modern .NET 10 web development patterns.

## Scope
- Interactive server-rendered web UI using Blazor components
- Dependency injection for services
- DataAnnotations validation for forms
- Responsive layout with sidebar navigation
- Simulated data services for demonstration

## Core Responsibilities
- Provide routable pages (Home, Counter, Weather, Error, NotFound)
- Display weather forecast data via IWeatherService
- Handle errors and 404s gracefully
- Support circuit reconnection for Blazor Server

## Non-Goals
- Not a real weather API client (uses simulation)
- Not a production contact form (ContactViewModel is a model only)
- No authentication/authorization
- No database persistence

## Architectural Constraints
- Business logic MUST live in Services, not in components
- Services MUST depend on Contracts (interfaces), not concrete implementations
- All public API surfaces MUST have API Reference documentation
- Components should be small and focused on presentation
- Use DI to access services from components
- Follow component lifecycle patterns (OnInitialized, OnParametersSet, etc.)
- Prefer cascading parameters for cross-component state sharing
- JS interop should be isolated in dedicated service classes

## Folder Structure
- Attributes/ — Custom attributes
- Contracts/ — DI interfaces (IWeatherService)
- Extensions/ — Static helper/extension classes
- Models/ — Data classes and DTOs (WeatherForecast, ContactViewModel)
- Options/ — Configuration classes
- Services/ — Implementations of Contracts (WeatherService)
- Components/Pages/ — Routable page components
- Components/Layout/ — Layout components (MainLayout, NavMenu, ReconnectModal)
- Components/Shared/ — Reusable shared components
- wwwroot/ — Static assets (CSS, JS, images)

## Technology Stack
- .NET 10
- Blazor Server (InteractiveServer render mode)
- Bootstrap 5 (via CDN/static assets)
- Nullable reference types enabled
- Implicit usings enabled
